measurement.schedule: phase-relative index/rate; fixed image order, decoded before ready
measurement.unsubmitted: explicit capacity or generator-late; lateness beyond max-lag or phase end never catches up silently
measurement.latency: successful requests planned in phase, including drain; async ready is actual SDK ready_at publication after synchronized execution and owning restoration; delivered follows get/consumption, including configured consumer delay
measurement.window_end: SDK unfinished uses ready timestamp; client undelivered uses delivered timestamp; v1 outstanding_at_window_end retains its historical ready-based definition
measurement.acceptance: DepthTiming; backend/admission failure distinguished; absolute admission/dequeue not exposed
measurement.stages: Host wall stages and CUDA Event device stages are separate; synchronize_ms overlaps queued device execution and is not additive
measurement.upload_bytes: Actual input upload bytes for successful backend completions; full CUDA uploads original RGB8, A/B upload FP32; incomplete failing backends are excluded; ORT uploads zero
measurement.throughput: success ready in [0,duration) / full duration; drain count and time separate
measurement.success_rate: all planned requests denominator; eventual and in-window rates separate
measurement.rss: process VmRSS sampled about every 50ms; excludes sampler process
measurement.cpu: delta process utime+stime / wall from /proc/PID/stat, 100 percent is one logical CPU; approximate 50ms samples
measurement.gpu: device total, includes background load; target 200ms; unavailable fields null; temperatures and clocks included
measurement.sampling_phase: stdout reception boundary, pipe/scheduling delay possible
measurement.bounds: <=1M requests, <=1024 images, <=256MiB decoded; stream CSV/logs/telemetry; bounded numeric samples for exact linear percentiles
measurement.repeats: independent SDK process each time; do not average P99
